name: real-season-import-staging
description: Staging-only variant of PR #36's real-season-import. Standalone Admin SDK script that imports the real Bedford & Kempston District Darts League Division 2 + Division 3 (Winter 2026/27) season into the chalkie-app-staging Firebase project, from the canonical dataset derived from the official fixture poster. Never run against any other project — see README.md before running anything.
